options.label: Fullscreen
options.description: Fill the screen with a borderless window. Off: a resizable window.

options.label: V-Sync
options.description: Show each frame on a display refresh. Off can tear, but frames appear sooner.

options.label: Frame Rate
options.description: Auto: 60, or 30 while the device is hot or can't hold 60. A steady 30 feels smoother than a shaky 60 (the Steam Frame's headset). The game keeps its speed.

options.label: Anti-Aliasing
options.description: Smooth jagged edges (an FXAA-style pass).

options.label: Upscaling
options.description: How the game's picture is enlarged to the window. Bicubic is sharp, bilinear softer. FSR 1 (AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1) keeps curves, wires and diagonals smooth when the window is much larger than the Internal Resolution (1x on a 1440p or 4K screen), for a little more GPU time.

options.label: Aspect Ratio
options.description: Fill other screen shapes: a wider view on an ultrawide, a taller one on a Steam Deck or a 4:3 iPad, the HUD at 16:9. Or 16:9 with bars.

options.label: Brightness
options.description: Lighter or darker shadows and mid-tones, a gentle step at a time, as a TV's brightness. Black and white stay put. 0 is the original picture.

options.label: Xbox 360 Display Gamma
options.description: The gamma ramp the game itself sets for a real Xbox 360's TV output: a little deeper shadows and brighter mid-tones, as on the console. Off: a flatter picture.

options.label: Sharpening
options.description: Extra sharpness for bicubic and FSR 1 upscaling (for FSR 1, the share of its sharpening pass's full strength). 0 turns it off.

options.label: Anisotropic Filtering
options.description: Keeps roads and walls sharp at a distance. Auto: 16x on a dedicated GPU or an M-series iPad, 4x on other integrated ones.

options.label: Mipmaps
options.description: Use the game's smaller textures in the distance, so they don't shimmer.

options.label: Internal Resolution
options.description: Render the 3D scene above the 360's 720p. 1.5x is 1080p, a little over half the pixels of 2x. Auto: from the screen (1440p: 2x, or 3x2 filling an ultrawide).

options.label: Master Volume
options.description: The volume of all game audio.

options.label: Mute
options.description: Silence all game audio.

options.label: Mute in Background
options.description: Silence the game while its window isn't focused.

options.label: Stick Deadzone
options.description: How far a stick moves before the game sees it. Raise it if the car steers by itself.

options.label: Trigger Deadzone
options.description: How far a trigger is pressed before it counts.

options.label: Vibration
options.description: Controller rumble.

options.label: Asynchronous Shaders
options.description: Skip an object for a frame or two while its shader compiles, instead of stuttering.

options.label: Performance Overlay
options.description: Show the frame rate and frame time in a corner of the screen.
